# Will your resume get shortlisted?
[preheader: A one-minute check shows the keywords your resume is missing for any job.]
Hi {{name}},

Many companies that hire freshers screen resumes with software (an ATS) before anyone reads them. If your resume does not use the words the job asks for, it can be passed over in seconds.

CVTara checks your resume against any job description, at no cost, and shows you:
- your match score for that job
- the keywords you are missing
- what to fix before you apply

[button: Check my resume | {{ats_url}}]

It takes about a minute, and placement season is a good time to fix it.

{{sender_name}}
